# David Anguita

> Independent software consultant based in Madrid, Spain. Fractional CTO and
> product engineering partner for early-stage and growing teams, with 15+ years
> building and advising on software products.

Canonical site: https://davidanguita.name

## Services

- Fractional CTO — on-demand senior technical leadership: technical strategy, stack, hiring and mentoring, hands-on delivery.
- Product Bootstrapping — from idea or MVP to a production-ready, maintainable foundation.
- Software Consulting — architecture, feature design, complex refactorings, code quality.
- AI-Assisted & Agentic SDLC — practical, controlled adoption of AI tools and agents in the development workflow.

## How to work together

- By project — a defined outcome with a plan and estimate.
- By fixed period — embedded, part-time, or short full-time sprints.
- As a fractional CTO — continuous, part-time technical direction.
